## Check SPSS Export Quality {.unnumbered}


### Description

Reads an exported <code>.sav</code> file and audits its structure to confirm that
variable labels, value labels, and missing value codes are correctly applied.
Prints a formatted summary report and invisibly returns a list of audit
results.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>check_sav_export(file_path, sentinel = -99, show_all = FALSE)
</code></pre>


### Arguments

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="file_path">file_path</code></td>
<td>
Character string. Path to the <code>.sav</code> file to check.
</td></tr>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="sentinel">sentinel</code></td>
<td>
Numeric. The missing value sentinel to look for.
Default <code>-99</code>.
</td></tr>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="show_all">show_all</code></td>
<td>
Logical. If <code>TRUE</code>, prints details for every variable
including those that pass all checks. If <code>FALSE</code> (default), only
prints variables with issues.
</td></tr>
</table>


### Value

Invisibly returns a list with components:


<dl>
<dt>variables</dt><dd>Data frame with one row per variable and audit columns.
</dd>
<dt>n_vars</dt><dd>Total number of variables.
</dd>
<dt>missing_var_labels</dt><dd>Variables with no variable label.
</dd>
<dt>missing_val_labels</dt><dd>Numeric variables with no value labels
(informational only &ndash; not all numeric vars need them).
</dd>
<dt>missing_na_values</dt><dd>Numeric variables where sentinel appears in
data but is not declared as SPSS missing.
</dd>
<dt>sentinel_not_found</dt><dd>Numeric variables with NAs in raw data but
no sentinel value found in export.
</dd>
</dl>
